name: 04b-append-calendar-blocked
note: 409 while an iteration runs, for the same reason as add-cities: each iteration's triage context is fixed at its start, and a mid-run append would make two batches of one run see different calendars. No Retry-After — appending is not urgent, and the remedy is simply 'between iterations'.

body.detail: Iteration 1 is running; append calendar events between iterations
